blocks.text: Thank you again for the time your team gave us last week. We have now worked through the territory and account assignments you sent over, and the picture of how the sales organization is arranged is coming together cleanly; Matthew Parrish has begun setting the outside comparables alongside it, and Jason Torres will walk you through where that stands when the three of us meet later this month.

To carry the reading further I need two things from your side. The first is the transaction-level detail behind the last two years of orders, so that we can see how price and discount were actually set rather than how policy intended them to be; the second is a half hour each with two of the account managers who carry your largest customers, since the texture behind the pipeline tends to live with the people who work it. If any of that needs a sign-off above your desk, Linda Gallegos, point me to the right person and I will approach them directly rather than add to your own load.

Send whatever is easiest straight to me, Nicole Griffin, and I will keep this thread as the single place these requests and their answers live, so that nothing for {{fact:f:E-2016-001.client}} goes missing between messages. If the transaction detail reaches us by the middle of next week, we stay comfortably on the footing we set at kickoff.
